control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on G-8101 and TT-8101 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on G-8101 and TT-8101 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 July 2010 a hazard report was recorded on G-8101 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during commissioning of replacement equipment; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
